Match Schedule Info - Daily Schedule

WEATHER UPDATE 8am Friday Morning

All matches oriiginally scheduled at 10am, 10:45am, 11am will now start at 11:30 due to rain overnight. Please check the website for further updates. Thanks for your patience and understanding.

START TIMES, LOCATION AND SURFACE

Please click on the DRAWS or the Match Schedule Info - Future Match Info to find your START TIMES.

All matches will be played on CLAY COURTS at TENNIS CENTER OF CORAL SPRINGS (TC on the draws) at 2575 Sportplex Drive, Coral Springs, 33065.

Tournament Schedule

Matches will begin on Thursday, December 27 in all categories.

UTR (Universal Tennis Rating) INFO

All results will be entered into the UTR (Universal Tennis Rating) database of results.
Welcome to the Tennis Center of Coral Springs

The Tennis Center of Coral Springs is one of the premier public facilities in the country. There are 12 clay and 4 hard courts (all lighted) with an attached pro shop. There is a snack bar with a menu that includes bagels, salads, sandwiches, candy, power bars, ice cream, drinks, wine and beer. There is also a locker room with showers and complimentary fruit and ice will be available throughout the tournament.

Schedule Conflicts

If you have a schedule conflict please contact me prior to publishing the draws by sending an email to LWTA10S@aol.com
Academies, Groups and Families

If you are playing with a training partner, academy team or group...please advise the Tournament Director in advance so you can be split up in the draw. You can email names to: lwta10s@aol.com. Please note that you must do this BEFORE the draws are published.
Withdrawals and Refunds

After the deadline any withdrawals will not be refunded. Thank you for your understanding of this policy. If you must withdraw, please do so on the computer by going to "EDIT REGISTRATION" prior to the entry deadline.

Player Selection Type

Players are selected manually by the tournament director after the close of registration.

Entry Type

Entry to this tournament is open to all USTA members. Entries must be submitted by Tuesday, December 25, 2018 11:59:00 PM Eastern Time. Only USTA members can register online if available.
